answer.short: Translate the given graph 1 unit right. The endpoint is $(1,0)$.
answer.worked:
Replace $x$ with $x-1$.
$$\begin{align*}y&=\sqrt{2(x-1)}\\y&=\sqrt{2x-2}\end{align*}$$
Translate every point 1 unit right. The endpoint moves from $(0,0)$ to $(1,0)$; the curve retains its increasing, concave-down shape.
